from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, date
import re
import openpyxl

def verify(workspace_path, external_services_path=None):
    posted_claims = ['CLM-10042', 'CLM-10047', 'CLM-10051', 'CLM-10058',
                     'CLM-10061', 'CLM-10071', 'CLM-10082']
    workspace = Path(workspace_path)
    candidates = list(workspace.glob('**/PBC_Audit_Log.xlsx'))
    if not candidates:
        candidates = [f for f in workspace.glob('**/*.xlsx') if 'audit' in f.name.lower()]
    if not candidates:
        return {'pass': False, 'score': 0.0,
                'feedback': "PBC_Audit_Log.xlsx not found in workspace: the Daily Posting Log was never uploaded. SOP Section 7.3 requires every Daily Posting Log to be uploaded to PBC_Audit_Log.xlsx before end of Business Day."}

    date_tokens = ['2026-03-31', '03/31/2026', '3/31/2026', '2026/03/31',
                   '31/03/2026', '20260331', 'march 31', 'mar 31', '31-mar', '31 mar']

    def cell_text(value):
        if value is None:
            return ''
        if isinstance(value, (datetime, date)):
            return value.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
        return str(value).strip()

    def compact(value):
        return re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '', cell_text(value).lower())

    def is_signoff_header(value):
        token = compact(value)
        return any(marker in token for marker in [
            'signoff', 'signature', 'signedby', 'approvedby',
            'approvalstatus', 'approvalrole', 'authorizationstatus',
            'approvername', 'approverrole', 'approverstatus'
        ])

    def row_has_scope(values):
        blob = ' '.join(cell_text(value) for value in values).lower()
        blob_nc = blob.replace(',', '')
        claim_hits = sum(1 for claim in posted_claims if claim.lower() in blob)
        return (any(token in blob for token in date_tokens)
                or 'batch2026033101' in blob
                or '2794.5' in blob_nc
                or claim_hits >= 2)

    def evaluate_signoff_fields(fields):
        present = [(header, cell_text(value)) for header, value in fields
                   if cell_text(value)]
        if not present:
            return False
        combined = ' '.join('%s: %s' % pair for pair in present).lower()
        combined_compact = compact(combined)
        manager_authorized = ('rcm manager' in combined
                              or 'revenue cycle manager' in combined
                              or 'rcmmanager' in combined_compact
                              or 'rcmsignoff' in combined_compact)
        auditor_authorized = ('resolution auditor' in combined
                              and ('on duty' in combined
                                   or 'on-duty' in combined
                                   or 'onduty' in combined_compact))
        negative = bool(re.search(
            r'\b(pending|awaiting|unsigned|declined|denied|rejected|unavailable|unassigned|incomplete|tbd|requested|scheduled|missing|blank|null|none)\b'
            r'|\bn\s*/?\s*a\b'
            r'|\bnot\s+(?:yet\s+)?(?:approved|signed|authorized|confirmed|provided|available|complete|completed)\b'
            r'|\bnot\s+applicable\b'
            r'|\bneeds?\s+(?:review|approval|authorization|sign(?:ature|[- ]?off)?)\b'
            r'|\bno\s+(?:manager\s+)?(?:sign(?:ature|[- ]?off)?|approval|authorization|approver)\b'
            r'|\b(?:will|to)\s+(?:be\s+)?(?:approved|authorized|confirmed|signed)',
            combined,
        ))
        if re.search(r'\b(billing specialist|certified medical coder|patient financial representative)\b', combined):
            negative = True
        if ('absent' in combined or 'out of office' in combined) and not auditor_authorized:
            negative = True
        values_text = ' '.join(value for _header, value in present).lower()
        affirmative = bool(re.search(
            r'\b(approved|authorized|confirmed|signed|complete|completed|yes)\b'
            r'|\bsign(?:ed)?[- ]?off\b'
            r'|\bapproval\s+complete\b',
            values_text,
        ))
        if not affirmative and not negative:
            non_signer_values = {
                'n/a', 'na', 'none', 'null', 'not provided', 'not applicable',
                'pending', 'requested', 'scheduled', 'tbd', 'absent',
                'unavailable', 'needs review', 'review required',
                'rcm manager', 'revenue cycle manager', 'resolution auditor',
                'on-duty resolution auditor', 'on duty resolution auditor',
                'billing specialist', 'certified medical coder',
                'patient financial representative',
            }
            for header, value in present:
                header_token = compact(header)
                is_direct_signer_field = (
                    ('signoff' in header_token or 'signature' in header_token
                     or 'signedby' in header_token or 'approvedby' in header_token
                     or 'approvername' in header_token)
                    and not any(part in header_token for part in ['status', 'role', 'date'])
                )
                normalized_value = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', value.strip().lower())
                name_tokens = re.findall(r"[A-Za-z][A-Za-z'.-]*", value)
                workflow_words = {
                    'approval', 'approved', 'authorization', 'authorized',
                    'confirm', 'confirmed', 'complete', 'completed',
                    'pending', 'awaiting', 'request', 'requested',
                    'schedule', 'scheduled', 'sign', 'signed', 'signoff',
                    'signature', 'review', 'required', 'later', 'provided',
                    'available', 'unavailable', 'absent', 'missing', 'blank',
                    'none', 'null', 'tbd', 'na', 'yes', 'no', 'not',
                    'will', 'to', 'follow', 'see', 'notes', 'note',
                    'forthcoming', 'notify', 'notified', 'notification',
                }
                role_words = {
                    'rcm', 'revenue', 'cycle', 'manager', 'resolution',
                    'auditor', 'billing', 'specialist', 'certified',
                    'medical', 'coder', 'patient', 'financial',
                    'representative', 'on', 'duty',
                }
                normalized_tokens = [
                    token.lower().strip(".'-") for token in name_tokens
                ]
                identity_tokens = [
                    token for token, normalized in zip(name_tokens, normalized_tokens)
                    if normalized not in role_words
                ]
                has_workflow_prose = any(
                    token in workflow_words for token in normalized_tokens
                )
                identity_is_name_shaped = bool(identity_tokens) and all(
                    token[:1].isupper() or token.isupper()
                    for token in identity_tokens
                )
                is_named_signer = (2 <= len(name_tokens) <= 5
                                   and identity_is_name_shaped
                                   and not has_workflow_prose
                                   and not any(char.isdigit() for char in value)
                                   and normalized_value not in non_signer_values)
                if is_direct_signer_field and is_named_signer:
                    affirmative = True
                    break
        return (not negative and affirmative
                and (manager_authorized or auditor_authorized))

    def has_authorized_signoff(workbook):
        for ws in workbook.worksheets:
            sheet_values = list(ws.iter_rows(values_only=True))
            sheet_scoped = any(row_has_scope(row) for row in sheet_values)
            if not sheet_scoped:
                continue

            # Columnar sign-off records, including separate Status and Role columns.
            for header_index in range(min(len(sheet_values), 20)):
                header_row = sheet_values[header_index]
                signoff_columns = [index for index, value in enumerate(header_row)
                                   if is_signoff_header(value)]
                if not signoff_columns:
                    continue
                for values in sheet_values[header_index + 1:]:
                    if not row_has_scope(values):
                        continue
                    fields = [(header_row[index], values[index] if index < len(values) else None)
                              for index in signoff_columns]
                    if evaluate_signoff_fields(fields):
                        return True

            # Structured key/value sign-off rows such as
            # ["RCM Manager Sign-off", "Jane Doe", "Approved"].
            for values in sheet_values:
                nonblank = [(index, value) for index, value in enumerate(values)
                            if cell_text(value)]
                if not nonblank or not is_signoff_header(nonblank[0][1]):
                    continue
                label = nonblank[0][1]
                fields = [(label, value) for _index, value in nonblank[1:]]
                if evaluate_signoff_fields(fields):
                    return True
        return False

    best_score = -1.0
    best_name = None
    best_missing = []
    ordered = sorted(candidates, key=lambda p: (p.name != 'PBC_Audit_Log.xlsx', p.name))
    for f in ordered:
        try:
            wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(f, data_only=True)
            parts = []
            for ws in wb.worksheets:
                parts.append(str(ws.title))
                for row in ws.iter_rows(values_only=True):
                    parts.extend(cell_text(value) for value in row if value is not None)
            blob = ' '.join(parts).lower()
        except Exception as e:
            if best_score < 0:
                best_score = 0.0
                best_name = f.name
                best_missing = ['could not open workbook: %s' % e]
            continue
        blob_nc = blob.replace(',', '')
        has_date = any(token in blob for token in date_tokens)
        claim_hits = sum(1 for claim in posted_claims if claim.lower() in blob)
        has_activity = ('batch2026033101' in blob or 'posting log' in blob
                        or 'daily posting' in blob or 'gross-to-net' in blob
                        or 'gross to net' in blob or '2794.5' in blob_nc
                        or claim_hits >= 2)
        has_signoff = has_authorized_signoff(wb)
        checks = [
            (has_date, "no Daily Posting Log record dated 2026-03-31 (today's date) found"),
            (has_activity, "no record of the day's Posted activity found (expected the Daily Posting Log to reference batch BATCH2026033101, the posted/deposited total $2,794.50, or the posted Claim IDs)"),
            (has_signoff, "no affirmative sign-off by an authorized RCM Manager or on-duty Resolution Auditor was found in the workbook's structured sign-off fields"),
        ]
        score = sum(1.0 for ok, _msg in checks if ok) / 3.0
        if score > best_score:
            best_score = score
            best_name = f.name
            best_missing = [msg for ok, msg in checks if not ok]
        if score >= 1.0:
            break

    if best_missing:
        return {'pass': False, 'score': round(max(best_score, 0.0), 4),
                'feedback': '%s: Daily Posting Log upload incomplete: %s' % (best_name, '; '.join(best_missing))}
    return {'pass': True, 'score': 1.0,
            'feedback': "%s: Daily Posting Log for 2026-03-31 uploaded with the day's posted activity and an affirmative authorized sign-off." % best_name}
